function.name: search_template_catalog_by_criteria
function.description: Searches the retrosynthetic template database based on specified criteria. The search criteria refer to the forward reaction.

molecule_smiles.description: SMILES string of the target molecule.
molecule_smiles.title: Molecule Smiles

functional_groups_broken.description: List of functional groups that are broken in the forward reaction. None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
functional_groups_broken.title: Functional Groups Broken

functional_groups_formed.description: List of functional groups that are formed in the forward reaction. None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
functional_groups_formed.title: Functional Groups Formed

bonds_formed.description: List of bonds that are formed in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6", "6-8"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
bonds_formed.title: Bonds Formed

bonds_broken.description: List of bonds that are broken in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6", "6-8"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
bonds_broken.title: Bonds Broken

bonds_order_changed.description: List of bonds whose order is changed in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6 (1.0->2.0)"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
bonds_order_changed.title: Bonds Order Changed

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return. Default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

messages.content:
Let me break down this task:

1. I need to propose a retrosynthesis route for the target molecule: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

2. The route must have exactly 6 reactions.

3. The hints describe the FORWARD reactions in order:
   - Step 1 (forward): Sulfonamide formation from aromatic amine + phenylsulfonyl chloride
   - Step 2 (forward): Nitro reduction to amine
   - Step 3 (forward): Nucleophilic aromatic substitution (S_NAr)
   - Step 4 (forward): Electrophilic aromatic bromination
   - Step 5 (forward): Wolff-Kishner reduction (ketone to alkane)
   - Step 6 (forward): Cyclization of chalcone to flavanone

Since I need to do RETROSYNTHESIS, I need to work backwards. The target molecule is the product of the forward sequence, so in retrosynthesis:
- The target was formed by reaction 1 (sulfonamide formation)
- Before that, we had a molecule with an amine (from reaction 2, nitro reduction)
- Before that, we had a molecule with a nitro group (from reaction 3, S_NAr)
- And so on...

Let me analyze the target structure:
O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

This contains:
- A sulfonamide linkage connecting an aromatic ring to a fluorophenyl group
- A protected piperazine substituent on the aromatic core
- A fused cyclic ether system

Working backwards from the target, the sulfonamide must have formed from coupling an aromatic amine with 4-fluorobenzenesulfonyl chloride. Before that step, the aromatic ring carried a nitro group that was reduced to the amine. Tracing further back reveals the piperazine was introduced via nucleophilic aromatic substitution, and the cyclic ether system arose from a flavanone cyclization of a chalcone precursor.
